# Copilot Instructions

Use `AGENTS.md` as the canonical project instructions and `TASKS.md` as the active scope.

This is a Roblox Luau public-FFA combat prototype. Generate small, typed, server-authoritative modules. A client may request an action and play predicted presentation, but it may not award damage, KOs, assists, meter, cooldown completion, currency, or respawns.

Before suggesting a new system, check `docs/MVP_SCOPE.md`. Do not add ranked 1v1, story, trading, gacha, a battle pass, a large city, or additional fighters during the combat-foundation milestone.

Treat values marked DEFAULT as tunable, DRAFT as unapproved, OPEN as unresolved, and LOCKED as product direction.
